solutionSql:
SELECT id, tracking_code
FROM shipments
WHERE RIGHT(tracking_code, 4) BETWEEN '0010' AND '0019'
ORDER BY id;

ambiguities.phrase: ends with a four-digit serial from 0010 to 0019 inclusive
ambiguities.readingChosen: Last four characters of tracking_code between '0010' and '0019' as text.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: A numeric serial from 10 to 19, or the summary's 'ids 10 through 19'. Each gives the same ten rows here.

notes: Tracking codes end in the zero-padded id, so the rule and the summary select the same shipments on this data.
